NAVAREA I WARNINGS LESS THAN 42 DAYS OLD (246/26 ONWARD) ARE PROMULGATED VIA ENHANCED GROUP CALL (EGC) AND/OR RELEVANT NAVTEX TRANSMITTERS. C.
